blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. In this lesson, Email Basics, you learn the everyday English you need when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting.

Today you learn 5 useful words. You practise them in short, natural sentences. Good IT habits protect the whole company. The email is working well today.

Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it. When something looks strange, you call IT support. The team is small, but very responsive. You are ready for the next IT task.

items.q: What does IT support at Czarnikow?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn 5 useful words."

items.q: When do you call IT support?
items.why: "When something looks strange, you call IT support."

items.q: "Good IT habits protect the whole company." The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: IT is only the IT team's job
items.why: Inferência: se bons hábitos protegem a empresa toda, eles importam para todos.

items.q: The text suggests that learning this lesson is…
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it." O tom é simples e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando sobre e-mail no Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm James, from the IT team. Let me show you how we use email here at Czarnikow. It's easy.

First, open your inbox. Your inbox has all your messages. Right now, you have three new emails. Look at the subject of each one. The subject tells you what the email is about.

This first email has an attachment. An attachment is a file, like a document or a photo. Click on it to open it. Be careful — only open attachments from people you know.

When you finish reading, you can send a reply. A reply is your answer. Sophie always sends a short, clear reply. That is a good habit.

Our IT team is small, but we are very responsive. If something looks strange, call us. We are happy to help. Okay? You are ready for your first email task. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "Hi! I'm James, from the IT team."

items.q: How many new emails do you have right now?
items.why: "Right now, you have three new emails."

items.q: What does the subject tell you?
items.why: "The subject tells you what the email is about."

items.q: Why does James say to open only attachments from people you know?
items.why: Inferência: "Be careful" mostra que é uma questão de segurança.

items.q: How does James want you to feel about your first email task?
items.why: Inferência: "You are ready… You can do it!" — o tom é encorajador e confiante.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please check your inbox for the new message." The inbox is…
items.why: Inbox = caixa de entrada, onde ficam suas mensagens.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The email has no ___, so I don't know what it is about."
items.why: Subject = assunto; ele diz do que o e-mail trata.

items.q: "I sent a short reply to Sophie." A reply is…
items.why: Reply = resposta / responder a uma mensagem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Click here to open the ___ — it is a PDF file."
items.why: Attachment = anexo, um arquivo (por exemplo, um PDF) junto ao e-mail.

items.q: "I get many messages by email every day." Email is…
options: a message sent on the computer
items.why: Email = e-mail, mensagem enviada pelo computador.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you send over the file?" To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = enviar algo para alguém.

items.q: "I will get back to you tomorrow." This means I will…
items.why: Get back to you = retornar, responder mais tarde.

items.q: "Please reply to the email." To reply to means to…
items.why: Reply to = responder ao e-mail.

items.q: "IT will help you out with the problem." To help you out means to…
items.why: Help you out = dar uma ajuda a alguém.

items.q: "Please log in to your email first." To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar (fazer login) com nome e senha.
